orca-lp-analytics v1.0.5

- No functional changes to analytics or on-chain operations.
- Documentation and core files remain unchanged in this version.
No user-facing changes in this release; documentation and functionality remain unchanged.

orca-lp-analytics v1.0.3

- The skill has expanded to orca-lp, adding on-chain management alongside analytics.
- Added support for opening, increasing, decreasing, collecting fees, closing, rebalancing LP positions, and swapping tokens on Orca pools.
- Seven new usage example files added for these actions: open, manage, rebalance, collect fees, close positions, swap, and quote.
- Documentation and triggers now cover both read-only analytics and write operations requiring a wallet.
- Updated requirements, APIs, and intent routing to support full-stack concentrated liquidity management.

No code or logic changes detected in this release.

- Version bump only; no user-facing changes.
- All documentation and functionality remain unchanged.

- Documentation updated: skill name changed from "orca-pool-analytics" to "lp-analytics" in SKILL.md.
- No logic, API, or feature changes — only SKILL.md was modified.

Initial release of orca-pool-analytics — view and analyze Orca Whirlpool pools without a wallet.

- Explore and compare Orca Whirlpool pools: discovery, ranking, and fee tier analysis.
- Assess pool stability with 6-month TVL, volume metrics, and risk signals.
- Recommend LP range sizes and containment rates based on historical data.
- Simulate future price paths using Monte Carlo projections.
- Calculate retrospective yield for any pool and range.
- All functionality is read-only and does not require wallet connection.
